about: The introitus of the formulary “Transfiguration of Our Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Your lightning illumined the world; the earth quivered and quaked. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O Lord of Hosts! My soul yearns and pines for the courts of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Your lightning illumined the world; the earth quivered and quaked.
